exposure: induction of labour at 41+5 weeks gestation
induction of labour at 42 weeks gestation
cohort: 18,247 women giving birth between 1 January 2009 and 12 December 2012 at Aarhus University Hospital in Denmark
finding: Earlier induction of labour at 41+5 weeks gestation was associated with an overall reduction in emergency caesarean section rates, but this effect was only statistically significant in nulliparous women.
